article.title: Saudi Arabia’s desperate situation
article.author: Editor
article.content: After relying on an unreliable Trump for defense, suspending normalization talks with Israel, and losing access to the Bab-al-Mandab Strait, Saudi Arabia turns to hesitant allies for help. The post Saudi Arabia’s desperate situation appeared first on MR Online .
